articles.title: Why bitcoin’s recent climb to $80,000 might just be a temporary liquidity squeeze
articles.snippet: Spot ETF outflows and a hawkish Federal Reserve are creating a "macro ceiling" that makes a new all-time high unlikely without a major geopolitical shift.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bittensor (TAO) rises 1.7%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Ripple (XRP) gained 1.6%, joining Bittensor (TAO) as a top performer.

articles.title: Turnkey raises $12.5 million in round backed by Circle Ventures and Sequoia Capital
articles.snippet: The new capital will primarily fund the development and public launch of Turnkey Verifiable Cloud, a secure computing product for digital assets.

articles.title: Stablecoin-powered neobank Fasset raises $51 million to expand across emerging markets
articles.snippet: The Shariah-compliant digital bank is part of a growing wave of fintech startups building banking and payments services on top of blockchain and stablecoin rails.

articles.title: Bank of England ready to water down 'overly conservative' stablecoin proposals: FT
articles.snippet: Restrictions proposed by the BOE prompted criticism from the crypto industry, which said they risked preventing the U.K. from being competitive in the digital economy.
